.kitchen
Churma laddu resipi | churma laddu | vistrit photo aur vidiyo resipi ke sath gujrati churme ke laddu. ghi, sukhe meve aur gur se bharpur pramanik aur paranprik gehun ka aata aadharit svadisht laddu resipi. yah paranprik rup se ganesh chaturthi ya divali ke mausam ke dauran taiyar kiya jata hai aur aamtaur par doston aur parivar ke sath parosa jata hai. yah mukhy rup se gujrati vyanjnon se aata hai, lekin vishesh rup se panjabi aur maharashtr vyanjnon sahit pashchimi bharat men pure bhartiy vyanjnon men phail gaya hai.
